metadata.description: The release tooling's suites about the release itself rather than the host: arming the release pull request, moving a copy's version, dispatching a publish, publishing to stand-in registries, the tracking issue and its API contract, and the version the published clients state. They drive the tool's command line over stand-ins on loopback and real copies of the tree, and read nothing that differs by platform. Nested in release-artifacts, whose fixtures and helpers they import, so they run once while that project's artifact and route proofs run on every platform.

typecheck.command: uv run -q ty check tools/release-artifacts/tests/independent && uv run -q ty check --python-platform win32 tools/release-artifacts/tests/independent

test.command: uv run -q coverage run -m pytest tools/release-artifacts/tests/independent
